newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-McIntosh to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-McIntosh to hold news conference.

text.p: Stock broker McIntosh Securities Ltd said on Tuesday it was likely to hold a mid-morning news conference to make an unspecified announcement.
"There's a meeting with the media being discussed for mid-morning," McIntosh chief executive John McGowan told Reuters. He would not say what would be announced.
Earlier on Tuesday Reuters reported from New York that Merrill Lynch & Co would buy McIntosh for A$114.4 million, or A$1.40 per share, quoting sources close to the situation.
The sources said the boards of both companies had approved the deal.
McIntosh shares rose sharply last week with the rumour of a takeover pushing the stock to a A$1.25 close on Friday compared with A$1.06 on Thursday morning.
Trade in McIntosh shares was halted on Monday morning pending an announcement.
